name: Mayor automatic business audit
headline: A clearer plan for your next 90 days.
summary: Automatic analysis of your public website and the business goals you supply, with cited findings, a separate automated review and a practical 30/60/90-day roadmap.

scope.name: Offer
scope.detail: How clearly the captured pages explain your products or services.

scope.name: Journey
scope.detail: The inquiry and booking paths described in the captured public pages.

scope.name: Trust
scope.detail: Trust information and evidence present in the captured pages.

scope.name: Conversion
scope.detail: Proposed improvements to the public inquiry path, each tied to the page evidence behind it.

scope.name: Operations
scope.detail: Practical workflow recommendations grounded in your supplied goals and public sources.

scope.name: Measurement
scope.detail: What to measure next and how to establish a baseline.

roadmap.detail: Establish a baseline, verify existing tools and prioritize the first changes.
Work through the next improvements and collect measurements.
Review what you measured and decide what to do next.

delivery: Verified payment queues your audit right away; your report goes through a separate automated review before it lands, so what you receive is checked, not raw.
boundaries: Research is built from your public webpages and the goals you supply, so every finding is cited and checkable — and your roadmap turns it into a concrete 30/60/90-day plan.
separateOffers: Its own focused automated report — distinct from MehyarSoft’s $330 founder-led Website Audit and the $5 automated website report.
